title: Vertical Sliced Wasserstein Distances for Meta-Measures
abstract: arXiv:2610.20743v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many modern learning problems require comparing probability distributions whose individual observations are themselves probability measures, naturally giving rise to meta-measures in $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\Omega))$. However, optimal transport distances on this space can be prohibitively expensive to evaluate. We introduce the vertical sliced Wasserstein ($\mathrm{VSW}$) distance, a scalable metric on $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\Omega))$. Rather than slicing along the transport geometry of $\mathcal{P}(\Omega)$, $\mathrm{VSW}$ projects each inner measure using continuous test functions and compares the resulting one-dimensional distributions with one-dimensional Wasserstein distance. We prove that $\mathrm{VSW}$ is a valid metric on $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\Omega))$, metrizes weak convergence, and admits dimension-independent statistical convergence guarantees. translated_title: 面向元测度的垂直切片 Wasserstein 距离
translated_abstract: 许多现代学习问题需要比较这样的概率分布：其单个观测本身即为概率测度，这自然产生了 $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\Omega))$ 中的元测度。然而，在该空间上评估最优传输距离的代价可能高得难以承受。我们引入了垂直切片 Wasserstein 距离（$\mathrm{VSW}$），这是 $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\Omega))$ 上的一种可扩展度量。$\mathrm{VSW}$ 并非沿 $\mathcal{P}(\Omega)$ 的传输几何进行切片，而是使用连续测试函数对每个内层测度进行投影，并用一维 Wasserstein 距离比较所得的一维分布。我们证明了 $\mathrm{VSW}$ 是 $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\Omega))$ 上的有效度量，能够度量化弱收敛，并具有与维度无关的统计收敛保证。实验表明，与现有方法相比，$\mathrm{VSW}$ 具有更高的精度和效率。
tldr: 本文提出垂直切片 Wasserstein（VSW）距离，一种面向元测度空间 $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\Omega))$ 的可扩展度量，通过连续测试函数投影内层测度实现高效计算，并证明了其度量性质与维度无关的统计收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the vertical sliced Wasserstein (VSW) distance, a scalable metric on the meta-measure space $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{P}(\Omega))$ that projects inner measures via continuous test functions, proving it is a valid metric with dimension-independent convergence guarantees and high empirical efficiency.
